961-graduate-courses-in-occupational-hea: Ph.D. and M.Sc.A. (Distance and Resident) aren't accepting applications. Multidisciplinary work on dust, chemical and radiation hazards. 961-school-of-population-and-global-heal: All at 2001 McGill College Ave., Suite 1200. Associate Dean and Director: Robert Platt. Chairs: Josée Dupuis (Epidemiology, Biostatistics and Occupational Health), Amélie Quesnel-Vallée (Equity, Ethics, and Policy), Madhukar Pai (Global and Public Health). See Minerva for all summer courses.

Taught in English; work may be in English or French. Credit for graduate students and McGill residents and fellows, through Minerva.
